title: US bond market closed all day for Veterans Day — a THURSDAY closure, so it lands inside November refunding week with equities trading a full session
source:
NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule ('Holiday Schedule', SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes) and re-parsed FIRST-HAND by this session rather than inherited: the plain HTML carries only the 2026 tab, so the 2027 cards were decoded out of the page's RSC payload and 119 holiday/date/note triples were extracted in order. Card 78 (inside the U.S. section, whose boundary is the page's own 'U.S. Holiday Recommendations'

) reads exactly 'Veterans Day' / 'Thursday, November 11, 2027' with an EMPTY note field — the full-closure shape, structurally distinct from the early-close cards in the same panel (card 79: 'Thanksgiving Day' / 'Thursday, November 25, 2027' / 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, November 26, 2027'). CORROBORATED FROM TWO FURTHER PRIMARIES, both fetched and parsed by this session. (1) NYSE nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes): all 109 data cells extracted, listing TEN holidays per year for 2026/2027/2028 — New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Washington's Birthday, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day — with ZERO occurrences of the strings 'Veterans', 'Columbus', 'Indigenous', 'November 11' or 'October 11' anywhere in the payload, so NYSE equities trade a full 09:30-16:00 ET session on 2027-11-11 while the recommended USD fixed-income tape is dark. (2) OCC www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) marks 2027-11-11 with holiday.description '

Bank holiday

' — its bond-only flag — against 2027-11-25's '

Exchange/
OCC holiday

' with hatched:true; those are the only two November 2027 holiday markers in the file. A THIRD, FULLY PRIMARY US-GOVERNMENT SOURCE corroborates by absence: api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov auctions_query, queried Novembers 1980-2026 one year at a time by this session, returns ZERO auctions dated November 11 in all 47 consecutive Novembers. Filed estimate on the same three counts every sibling SIFMA entry records, none of which is doubt about the date: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an industry trade association's recommended schedule (TSY: covers a Treasury AUCTION schedule, and the 47-year zero is corroboration by absence rather than a Treasury statement naming the holiday), this lane may not self-confirm an event it took over from an in-sweep proposal, and SIFMA's schedule is a recommendation rather than a market-wide halt each firm is bound by. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE sifma-bond-market-closure-2027-11-11 initial research (2026-09-08), which read the one prior proposal for this id first: proposals/sifma-bond-market-closure-2027-11-11.from-thanksgiving-market-closure-2027-11-25.json, filed the same day at D-14 from its proposer and honest about being outside the +/-5-day corridor. Every source claim in that proposal was re-fetched and re-parsed first-hand here rather than inherited, and all of them held. WHAT THIS ENTRY ADDS THAT THE PROPOSAL AND THE 2026 SIBLING COULD NOT. (1) THE WEEKDAY IS THE WHOLE STORY. 2027-11-11 is a THURSDAY, and November 2027 is the exact calendar twin of November 2021 (both start on a Monday, both put Veterans Day on Thursday the 11th and refunding settlement on Monday the 15th). In BOTH prior Thursday-Veterans-Day Novembers inside the modern 3y/10y/30y refunding regime, Treasury compressed the slate onto Mon/Tue/Wed and the 30-YEAR BOND AUCTIONED ON WEDNESDAY THE 10TH -- 2010-11-10 and 2021-11-10, verified from api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov -- against a Thursday 30-year in 12 of the 16 Novembers 2010-2025. The routine Thursday 4-week/8-week bill slate moved the same way in 2021 (Wed 2021-11-10, vs Thursdays either side of it). So the 2027 shape is supply taken down at D-1 and then a dark session, the mirror image of 2026, where the tracked treasury-30y-bond-2026-11-12 sits at D+1. (2) THE STORY THAT SHAPE SUGGESTS IS REFUTED HERE, NOT LEFT OPEN. In both analogs the largest post-closure TLT move landed on refunding-settlement Monday (2021-11-15: -1.26%, 1.67x its trailing-20 median |move|; 2010-11-15: -2.09%, 2.74x). Across all 17 November refunding settlements since 2009 the median is 0.588x -- QUIETER than the 0.995x all-session baseline -- with 5 of 17 above 1.5x. The two analogs are the tails of that distribution, not the rule. (3) SIFMA'S OWN 2027 JAPAN PANEL IS SELF-LABELLED TENTATIVE. Every 2027 Japan card, Veterans Day included, carries the note 'Tentative - Subject to confirmation by the Bank of Japan'; the 2027 US and UK cards carry an empty note, and no 2026 card in any region carries it. So the Japan leg's uncertainty is the source's own words, while the US leg's `estimate` label is purely our taxonomy gap. (4) THE +/-5-DAY CORRIDOR IS EMPTY IN THIS CALENDAR AND THAT IS A SEEDING GAP, NOT A QUIET WEEK. Zero tracked events, canonical or proposed, are dated 2027-11-06..2027-11-16; the identical corridor around 2026-11-11 carries six. November refunding week, an October CPI print, PPI, MTS and the refunding settlement will all land in that window and none is tracked at this horizon. Do not read the empty corridor as calm. ID-CLASS CALL, MADE RATHER THAN DEFERRED (the proposal left it 'for whoever takes the entry'): this keeps `sifma-bond-market-closure-*`, which 3 of the 4 full-closure entries on this calendar already use; sifma-bond-holiday-close-2027-10-11 is the lone outlier, and renaming another event's canonical file is outside this lane's envelope, so the inconsistency is recorded here rather than resolved. STRUCTURAL AND LOW-IMPACT ONLY: a recommended closure moves nothing by itself, no house playbook is calendar- or holiday-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped this session for holiday|veterans|columbus|closure|half-day|early close: zero hits in both), and this widens caution about cross-asset reads on 11-11 while licensing nothing. HONEST LIMITS. (1) EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no market-structure member, so this is filed 'rates', the choice every sibling SIFMA entry already made. (2) CME futures hours on 2027-11-11 are NOT asserted: cmegroup.com has 403'd this runner across every sibling lane and was not re-attempted. (3) The Wednesday-30y read for 2027 is pattern-derived, NOT sourced -- Treasury's tentative auction schedule does not reach November 2027 yet, so no proposal file was created for it and it is registered as a forward test instead. (4) bls.gov returned HTTP 403 to this runner (recorded in the ledger's probe-ref.blocked), so no October-2027 CPI date was proposed for the corridor. Impact low, symbols [] -- estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
